title: The lead holds management by exception as an autonomy value
situation: The efficiency concept no longer states that a run far beyond its size is stopped and reported; that behaviour is the lead's own value, management by exception in PRINCE2's sense, and the composed lead does not carry it.
decision: A new autonomy value, management-by-exception: work runs within its tolerance, the user story's rough cost, and a forecast past that tolerance is raised to the level above, never pushed on. It is composed into the lead's autonomy beside mission-command; no other agent gains it. The checks pinning the composed lead and the canon's catalog change with it. One builder.
consequences: The delivered lead states its tolerance and escalation in the established name; the efficiency concept stays a measure only.
